beach.name: 塔赞渔滩
beach.desc: 塔赞之城外的一小片沙滩，几名渔人在此浅滩垂钓。这里只有一根鱼竿、一只水桶，以及今日上钩的收获。
beach.descEn: A short strip of sand just outside the City of Tazan, where a few anglers work the shallows. Nothing here but a rod, a bucket, and whatever is biting today.

fish.name: 白骨鱼骸
fish.desc: 曾在此游弋之物只余白骨，其余的都进了海鸥的肚子。商人愿意为它付出可观的金币。
fish.descEn: Whatever swam here left only bone. The gulls got the rest. A merchant will pay good gold for it.

fish.name: 条纹文蛤
fish.desc: 紧闭如铁，比看上去更沉。厨子们最爱用它熬汤。商人愿意为它付出可观的金币。
fish.descEn: Sealed tight and heavier than it looks. Cooks swear by the broth. A merchant will pay good gold for it.

fish.name: 锈钳螯虾
fish.desc: 双钳能夹碎指节。徒手去抓也值得冒这个险。商人愿意为它付出丰厚的金币。
fish.descEn: Its pincers can crack a knuckle. Worth the risk of catching one by hand. A merchant will pay handsomely for it.

fish.name: 月鳞鲦
fish.desc: 苍白如沉底的银币。渔妇说它只在无云之夜浮上来。商人愿意为它付出丰厚的金币。
fish.descEn: Pale as a drowned coin. Fishwives say it only rises on cloudless nights. A merchant will pay handsomely for it.

fish.name: 辉鳍神仙鱼
fish.desc: 日落之后，鳞片仍久久含光。收藏家愿以重金求一条完好的。商人愿意为它掏出一小笔财富。
fish.descEn: Its scales hold light long after the sun is gone. Collectors pay in gold for a whole one. A merchant will pay a small fortune for it.

fish.name: 珊瑚绯鱼
fish.desc: 礁石般的绯红，触手温热。一离开浅水便会死去。商人愿意为它掏出一小笔财富。
fish.descEn: Reef-red and warm to the touch. It dies the moment it leaves the shallows. A merchant will pay a small fortune for it.

fish.name: 青斑鱼
fish.desc: 每秒回复10点生命，持续1小时。
fish.descEn: Restore 10 Life per second for 1 hour.

fish.name: 霜蚀鱼骨
fish.desc: 弯曲的鱼骨在湖冰下磨得光滑，原本的鱼儿几乎不留痕迹。商人愿意为它们付出不少金币。
fish.descEn: Curved bones polished smooth beneath the lake ice. Little remains of the fish they held together. A merchant will pay good gold for them.

fish.name: 霜纹螺壳
fish.desc: 蓝色螺壳的每道棱纹都凝着白霜，即使放在熊熊炉火旁也依旧冰冷。商人愿意为它慷慨解囊。
fish.descEn: Frost clings to every ridge of this blue spiral shell. It stays cold beside a roaring fire. A merchant will pay handsomely for it.

fish.name: 碧蓝帆鳍鱼
fish.desc: 宽大的蓝色鱼鳍在冰下如丝绸般舒展。两侧闪烁的条纹令收藏家趋之若鹜。商人愿意为它掏出一小笔财富。
fish.descEn: Its broad blue fins unfurl like silk beneath the ice. Collectors prize the shimmering stripes along its sides. A merchant will pay a small fortune for it.

fish.name: 霜光水母
fish.desc: 每秒恢复4点法力，持续1小时。
fish.descEn: Restore 4 Mana per second for 1 hour.
fish.effect: 每秒恢复4点法力，持续1小时

fish.name: 硫磺泥鳅
fish.desc: 它盘绕在湖底热泉暖透的石头上。离水许久，黄色的鱼鳍仍在抽动。商人愿意为它付出丰厚的金币。
fish.descEn: It curls around stones warmed by vents below the lakebed. Its yellow fins twitch long after it leaves the water. A merchant will pay handsomely for it.

fish.name: 烬纹螺壳
fish.desc: 沉重的螺壳上盘绕着暖琥珀色的纹带。细灰积聚在沟纹之中。商人愿意为它掏出一小笔财富。
fish.descEn: Warm amber bands wind around this heavy spiral shell. Fine ash gathers in its grooves. A merchant will pay a small fortune for it.

fish.name: 烬壳蟹
fish.desc: 受到的所有伤害减少10%，持续1小时。
fish.descEn: Reduce all damage taken by 10% for 1 hour.
fish.effect: 受到的所有伤害减少10%，持续1小时

beach.name: 塔赞渔滩
desc: A short strip of sand just outside the City of Tazan, where a few anglers work the shallows. Nothing here but a rod, a bucket, and whatever is biting today.
塔赞之城外的一小片沙滩，几名渔人在此浅滩垂钓。这里只有一根鱼竿、一只水桶，以及今日上钩的收获。

snowLake.name: 维尔达克天池
desc: A clear lake nestled among Veldak's snowy peaks. Strange fish stir in its icy depths, while patient anglers cast their lines from the frozen shore.
一汪清澈的天池静卧于维尔达克的雪峰之间。奇异的鱼儿游弋在冰冷的深水中，耐心的渔人从结霜的岸边垂下钓线。

volcanoLake.name: 灰烬湖
desc: Ash drifts over the warm waters beneath the Cinder Crown. On the blackened shore, anglers listen to the volcano rumble as they wait for the next bite.
灰烬之冠脚下，浮灰在温暖的湖面上飘荡。渔人守在焦黑的岸边，听着火山的低鸣，等待鱼儿再次咬钩。
